name: AISoftSurface
description: A tinted container using the --ai-surface scale. The primary non-textual attribution affordance for a region of AI output.
intent: The wash that says everything inside this boundary was machine-generated.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

props.name: tone
props.hint: One of the tone values declared in aiSoftSurfaceVariants.

props.name: intensity
props.hint: One of the intensity values declared in aiSoftSurfaceVariants.

props.name: elevation
props.hint: One of the elevation values declared in aiSoftSurfaceVariants.

props.name: bordered
props.hint: One of the bordered values declared in aiSoftSurfaceVariants.

props.name: radius
props.hint: One of the radius values declared in aiSoftSurfaceVariants.

props.name: asChild
props.hint: Renders the child element instead of the default one, merging props and styles. Use for links that must look like this component.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

notes: A tinted background is invisible to screen readers. The visual wash is NOT sufficient attribution on its own.
Always pair it with text attribution — ai:ai-message-header, or an aria-label on the region.
Contrast: --ai-surface is deliberately close to the page background, so any text inside still needs a foreground token, never a lightened one.

agentRules: Never wrap human-authored content in it.
The wash is not attribution by itself — pair it with ai:ai-message-header or a labelled region.
One surface per region. Do not nest.
Reserve expressive intensity for hero surfaces.
